record.original_question: Prove stronger theoretical bounds for GECP applied to $K$, by exploiting the structure of the kernel $K$.

evidence.quote: Prove stronger theoretical bounds for GECP applied to $K$, by exploiting the structure of the kernel $K$.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $K:[0,1]\times[0,1]\to\mathbb{R}$ be the Lehmann kernel, by which we mean a symmetric positive semidefinite kernel of the form
$$K(x,y)=\min(x,y)\,(1-\max(x,y))$$
(the Green's function for $-d^2/dx^2$ on $[0,1]$ with Dirichlet boundary data), and for any set of nodes $0<x_1<x_2<\cdots<x_n<1$ let $K_n\in\mathbb{R}^{n\times n}$ be the kernel matrix with entries $(K_n)_{ij}=K(x_i,x_j)$.

Apply Gaussian Elimination with Complete Pivoting (GECP) to $K_n$. Recall that GECP produces, after $n$ steps, a factorization $P K_n Q = L U$ with $L$ unit lower triangular, $|L_{ij}|\le 1$, and $U$ upper triangular; let $K_n^{(k)}$ denote the trailing Schur complement after $k$ elimination steps, and define the growth factor
$$\rho_n(K_n) \;=\; \frac{\max_{k,i,j}\bigl|\bigl(K_n^{(k)}\bigr)_{ij}\bigr|}{\max_{i,j}|(K_n)_{ij}|}.$$
Wilkinson's general bound gives $\rho_n \le n^{1/2}\bigl(2\cdot 3^{1/2}\cdots n^{1/(n-1)}\bigr)^{1/2}$ for an arbitrary $n\times n$ matrix.

Problem. By exploiting the structure of the Lehmann kernel $K$ (its total positivity, smoothness, and Green's-function representation), prove growth-factor bounds for GECP applied to $K_n$ that are strictly stronger than Wilkinson's general bound; in particular, establish whether $\rho_n(K_n)$ can be bounded by a polylogarithmic function of $n$, or even by a constant independent of $n$ and of the choice of nodes $\{x_i\}$, and derive correspondingly improved bounds on the entrywise backward error of the resulting LU factorization.
artifact.category_tag: Numerical linear algebra: pivoting growth factors
artifact.status_search_result: A targeted web search did not locate any published result establishing structure-exploiting GECP growth bounds specifically for Lehmann kernel matrices. Recent activity on GECP growth (e.g., Bisain–Edelman–Urschel 2023 improving Wilkinson's bound, and work on butterfly and orthogonal matrices) addresses general or different structured classes, leaving the Lehmann-kernel case unaddressed in the literature found. Status is therefore reported as open based on absence of a matching solution.

status_evidence.title: Growth factors of orthogonal matrices and local behavior of Gaussian elimination with partial and complete pivoting
status_evidence.snippet: Wilkinson's upper bound remained essentially the best for over six decades until Bisain, Edelman, and Urschel (2023) lowered it to about n^{0.2079} log n.
status_evidence.claim: State-of-the-art GECP growth bounds are general; no Lehmann-kernel-specific bound is established.

status_evidence.title: Complete pivoting growth of butterfly matrices and butterfly Hadamard matrices
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work computes exact GECP growth for butterfly matrices, indicating active research into structure-specific GECP bounds.
status_evidence.claim: Structure-specific GECP analyses exist for some matrix families but not for Lehmann kernel matrices.
